The WHERE clause grouping used `tlist.tokens[eidx - 2]` to find the end token of the WHERE group when a closing keyword (ORDER BY, UNION, RETURNING, etc.) was found, but it should have been `tlist.tokens[eidx - 1]` (the token immediately preceding the closing keyword, typically whitespace).
